scripts.test:python:coverage: coverage run -m pytest -q -p no:cov && coverage report -m
scripts.test:python:coverage:json: coverage erase && coverage run -m pytest -q -p no:cov && coverage json -o coverage/python-coverage.json
scripts.coverage:badges: npm run test:frontend:coverage && npm run test:python:coverage:json && python tools/generate_coverage_badges.py
scripts.test:all: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:python
